info.title: PerioVision AI API
info.description: Clinical decision support for periodontal bone loss. Every JSON response uses the envelope {data, meta, error, mode}. Authenticate with POST /api/auth/login, then send 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'. x-permission names the RBAC permission each operation requires (see docs/SECURITY.md).
